You preferably want your DPS ( Vortice ) in either 1st or 2nd postion because on 3rd postion you will get hit by effects or damages with pierce and if front dies then they are next.

Cassiah is too RNG to be reliable and you don't want to discard your deck to reshuffle with Vortice on the team since she need to prepare her cards to lower the costs, you're way better off with ramona to compensate with the problem of arithmetica management.

Alva tank is good but not for that team because of hand size, her taunt already draw a lot of cards and vortice alone need a lot of hand size in order to prepare them properly, one of the other option can be aigis. 

Thais + vortice can be a good combo but you might need a support / healer that can actually cleanse reliably, either tinct or doll.
Problem is even though it seems good, in current meta that vortice get sniped in turn 2 and her whole kit rely on preparing her cards
